missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шутка' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Смешная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Шутку' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'рассказал'. 'Интересную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Шутки' takes the genitive after the negated verb 'не понял'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Над шуткой' uses the instrumental after 'над' with 'смеяться'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря шутке' uses the dative after 'благодаря' to show the cause. 'Веселее' is a comparative adverb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В шутке' uses the prepositional after 'в' to locate the content. 'Правда' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Шутки' is the inanimate feminine accusative plural object of 'любит', identical to the nominative plural. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Шуток' is the genitive plural after 'от', showing the cause. Note the fleeting vowel that appears in the genitive plural form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of quantity. 'Шуток' takes the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Добрых' agrees in the genitive plural with the fleeting-vowel noun.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'две' the noun takes the genitive singular 'шутки'. 'Новые' is the nominative plural adjective used with this numeral pattern.
